Ālekhana
ancient mīm. an. śrauta authority, referred to by Jaimini under VI. v. 17, in support of his own view; also referred to in the Saṅkarṣakāṇḍa under XVI. ii. 1; frequently quoted in the Śrautasūtras of Āpastamba: Sūtras V. 29. 14; IX. 3. 15; 4. 9; 6. 3; 10. 12; 16. 6; 19. 4; X. 16. 4; XIV. 13. 8; 22. 13; XIX. 6. 10; 8. 8; XXI. 3. 8; 15. 6; 19. 20; Āśvalāyana VI. 10. 29 an. Bhāradvāja also. Often holds views opposed to those of Āśmarathya.

Ālekhanamata
Q. in Raghunātha Navahasta's Prāyaścitta Kutūhala. BBRAS. 618.
